request: In a single solution containing 1 mM Cu(II), 1 mM Fe(III), 10 mM citrate, 10 mM glycine, 0.1 M chloride, and 0.1 M ammonia at 25 C and I=0.1 m, build the joint two-dimensional E-pH Pourbaix diagram over pH 0-14 and E=-1.0 to +1.5 V_SHE. Hydrated species are preferred for this water-rich scenario about electrodeposition electrolyte design, and do not keep Fe2O3, CuO, FeOOH and Fe3O4. Identify how Cu and Fe partition among species, and report the principal region boundaries and junctions using the equilibrium constants and potentials actually used by the solver.
